description.value: Sanctuary Cafe is a bike-friendly community coffee shop on the eastern edge of Steveston Village, deliberately positioned along a popular year-round cycling and running route in Richmond. Owner Tim Lee is an avid cyclist who has ridden iconic climbs in the Alps and Dolomites, and the cafe partners with local clubs Steveston Velo and Steveston Run Crew to foster a cycling and running community. The menu rotates BC-roasted coffees alongside artisan baked goods and hearty handhelds designed to fuel riders before, during, or after a ride.
